name: Mothmen 1966
source:
You are Lee, a college student obsessed with the American Civil War. Someone at school told you about Holt’s gas station outside town, just the spot to watch the upcoming meteor shower for a perfect date with your girlfriend. But at Holt's you’ll meet Lou Hill, a writer investigating the link between these meteor storms and sightings of human-size winged creatures with red, glowing eyes. It seems to Lou that whenever these 'mothmen' are spotted, bad things happen...

Created by novelist Nico Saraintaris and artist Fernando Martinez Ruppel, ‘Pixel Pulps’ are a fusion of exceptional writing and stunning illustration, inspired by mid-20th century pulp fiction and 80s home computer graphics.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755030/Mothmen_1966/]Steam[/url]].
translation:
你是李，一名痴迷于美国南北战争的大学生。学校里有人告诉你，镇外的霍尔特加油站，是带女友观赏即将到来的流星雨、来场完美约会的绝佳地点。然而，在那里，你会遇见作家卢·希尔。他正调查这些流星雨，与某种人类大小、双眼泛着红光的有翼生物目击事件之间的联系。在卢看来，每当天蛾人现身，坏事就会发生……

小说家尼科·萨赖因塔里斯与画家费尔南多·马丁内斯·鲁佩尔共同创作的“Pixel Pulps”系列，将出色的文字与惊艳的插画结合，灵感来自20世纪中叶的通俗小说，以及80年代家用电脑的图像风格。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755030/Mothmen_1966/]Steam[/url]]。
